name: Government and Policy Leaders
blurb: Regulators, legislators, and agency officials shaping AI rules.

members.hook: Ritualo sits at a position that barely existed five years ago: the combined Chief Data and AI Officer function inside a cabinet-level foreign policy agency. Her career was built entirely on the federal data and performance management side, monitoring and evaluation, division chief, deputy CDAO, making her one of the few senior government AI officers whose path to the role ran through data governance and program evaluation rather than technology procurement.
members.name: Amy Ritualo
members.moniker: Acting Chief Data and AI Officer, U.S. Department of State

members.hook: Yang forced automation and AI's threat to jobs onto the American political stage years before generative AI made the subject unavoidable, building an entire 2020 presidential campaign, and a signature policy proposal, around the argument that AI-driven job loss required a fundamental rethink of the social safety net.
members.name: Andrew Yang
members.moniker: Politician Who Made Automation a National Issue

members.hook: Sachdeva built a career converting large-scale corporate transactions, over $11 billion of them, into working technology systems, from integrating GE's manufacturing ERPs to modernizing Sabre's airline cloud infrastructure, before bringing that private-sector integration discipline to the U.S. Air Force as its Chief Information Officer.
members.name: Deepak Sachdeva
members.moniker: Chief Information Officer, United States Air Force

members.hook: Li made modern AI's breakthrough possible by betting on data before it was fashionable: ImageNet's fourteen million labeled images gave the field the benchmark on which AlexNet proved deep learning worked. She has spent the years since insisting the technology stay pointed at people, building Stanford HAI and carrying the human-centered case into policy rooms from Sacramento to Washington.
members.name: Fei-Fei Li

members.hook: Tripathi has spent his career on the unglamorous but consequential work of making health data actually move between systems, first from the policy side as the U.S. government's top health IT official, and now from inside a leading hospital system, applying that same interoperability and governance discipline to how AI gets deployed in clinical care.
members.name: Micky Tripathi
members.moniker: Federal Architect of Health AI Policy

members.hook: Preston moved from running two federal agencies during the 2008 financial crisis to leading Goodwill Industries, where he has directed the organization's push to use AI-enabled training tools to help workers displaced by automation move into new careers, applying crisis-era public administration experience to AI's labor disruption.
members.name: Steve Preston
